mapper.select: SELECT r.review_no, r.subject, r.content, r.hit, r.goods_no, r.id, r.like_count, r.created_at, r.image, g.goods_name AS "goods.goods_name", g.poster_url AS "goods.poster_url", m.nickname FROM review r JOIN goods g ON r.goods_no = g.goods_no JOIN member m ON r.id = m.id WHERE r.review_no = #{review_no}

SELECT od.order_no, od.goods_no,r.review_no, g.goods_name AS "goods.goods_name", g.poster_url AS "goods.poster_url", o.delivery_status AS "ov.delivery_status", o.order_date AS "ov.order_date" FROM ORDER_DETAIL od JOIN GOODS g ON od.goods_no = g.goods_no JOIN ORDERS o ON od.order_no = o.order_no LEFT JOIN REVIEW r ON r.order_no = od.order_no AND r.goods_no = od.goods_no WHERE o.id = #{id}
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC

SELECT od.order_no, od.goods_no, g.goods_name AS "goods.goods_name", g.poster_url AS "goods.poster_url" FROM ORDER_DETAIL od JOIN GOODS g ON od.goods_no = g.goods_no WHERE od.order_no = #{order_no} AND od.goods_no = #{goods_no}
